responsibility: Implements Atom-family scheduler reordering hooks for the x86 backend. It contains the ready-list heuristics used by post-reload scheduling on Bonnell, Silvermont, and the generic in-order Intel model to improve issue decisions around pipelined integer multiplies, dependency timing, and load preference, and exports the ix86_atom_sched_reorder hook that adjusts ready-list order while preserving the core issue-rate model supplied elsewhere.
